effect: Held: Water-Type moves from holder do 20% more damage. Breeding: Mantine begets a Mantyke Egg.

name: Weakness Policy
desc: If holder is hit super effectively, raises Attack, Sp. Atk by 2 stages. Single use.
effect: Held: When the holder is hit by a super effective move, its Attack and Special Attack raise by two stages.

name: Wellspring Mask
desc: Ogerpon-Wellspring: 1.2× power attacks; Terastallize to gain Embody Aspect.

name: Wepear Berry
desc: Cannot be eaten by the holder. No effect when eaten with Bug Bite or Pluck.
effect: Used for creating PokéBlocks and Poffins.

name: Whipped Dream
desc: Evolves Swirlix into Slurpuff when traded.
effect: Traded on a Swirlix: Holder evolves into Slurpuff.

name: White Herb
desc: Restores all lowered stat stages to 0 when one is less than 0. Single use.
effect: Held: Resets all lowered stats to normal at end of turn. Consumed after use.

name: Wide Lens
desc: The accuracy of attacks by the holder is 1.1×.
effect: Held: Provides a 1/10 (10%) boost in accuracy to the holder.

name: Wiki Berry
desc: Restores 1/3 max HP at 1/4 max HP or less; confuses if -SpA Nature. Single use.
effect: Held: Consumed at 1/2 max HP to restore 1/8 max HP. Confuses Pokémon that dislike dry flavor.

name: Wise Glasses
desc: Holder's special attacks have 1.1× power.
effect: Held: Boosts the damage of special moves used by the holder by 1/10 (10%).

name: Yache Berry
desc: Halves damage taken from a supereffective Ice-type attack. Single use.
effect: Held: Consumed when struck by a super-effective Ice-type attack to halve the damage.

name: Zap Plate
desc: Holder's Electric-type attacks have 1.2× power. Judgment is Electric type.
effect: Held: Electric-Type moves from holder do 20% more damage. Changes Arceus’s and Judgment’s type to Electric.

name: Zeraorite
desc: If held by a Zeraora, this item allows it to Mega Evolve in battle.

name: Zoom Lens
desc: The accuracy of attacks by the holder is 1.2× if it moves after its target.
effect: Held: Provides a 1/5 (20%) boost in accuracy if the holder moves after the target.

name: Zygardite
desc: If held by a Zygarde in Complete Forme, this item allows it to Mega Evolve in battle.
